invariant_bindings.invariant_text: A new key version MUST be produced on or before next_rotation_at; missing a rotation SHALL raise an alert to the compliance channel.
overlap MUST be > 0 so decryption of records written with the prior version NEVER fails during cutover.
active_key() MUST return exactly one current key per alias at any instant; ties or gaps CANNOT occur.
Keys past cadence + overlap MUST be marked decrypt-only; new writes with such keys SHALL be rejected.
Rotation events MUST emit a TamperEvidentAuditLog entry capturing old and new key versions.
